resources.string: Lets the AMC agent read the screen and operate apps for you: it can see the text and buttons of the app in front (never the content of password fields), tap, type, scroll, swipe and press Back, Home and Recents. It only acts while you watch the \"AMC is in control\" banner with its Stop button, and only for tasks you give it. Banking, password and authenticator apps are blocked by default. Sending messages, payments, installs, deletions and settings changes always ask you first. AMC never unlocks or bypasses your lock screen.
Shown while AMC operates your phone, with a Stop button
Tap Stop to end it immediately.
AMC can take screenshots while it controls your phone
